mechanics.name: Flip-Flop
mechanics.currentEffect: While in the Dying State, your Recovery progress also charges your Wiggle Meter at 50% of the Recovery rate, up to a cap of 40/45/50% Wiggle progression. The accumulated Wiggle progress remains available if the Killer picks you up.
activation: You must be in the Dying State and perform the Recovery action.
Ends/deactivates when: Additional conversion stops at the tier's maximum Wiggle progression cap.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Recovering while downed banks part of your Wiggle progress before the Killer picks you up.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: Recovery progress is converted to Wiggle progress at 50% of the Recovery rate until the tier-specific cap of 40/45/50% is reached; no tokens are used.
specialInteractions: The Wiggle progression accumulated while recovering remains when the Survivor is picked up.

editorial.summary: While downed, convert half of your recovery progress into stored wiggle progress for the moment the Killer picks you up.
useCases: Preload wiggle progress while the Killer leaves you on the ground.
Enable fast Power Struggle activation after pickup.
Make prolonged slugging increase the risk of a carry escape.
counters: Provides little value if the Killer picks you up immediately.
Cannot by itself force the Killer to cross a pallet or miss a hook.
cons: Usually needs another perk to cash the stored progress into something meaningful.
analysis: Flip-Flop follows Power Struggle at this position because the two are almost a package. Ground recovery becomes future wiggle progress, which can move Power Struggle past its activation threshold almost immediately after pickup.
Even without Power Struggle, the stored progress makes long slugging more dangerous for the Killer. A Survivor who is left down for a substantial time begins the carry much closer to escaping.
The limitation is that the Killer can deny most of the perk simply by picking up quickly. Flip-Flop also does not control hook distance, carry route, or pallet geometry.
It therefore ranks as a strong synergy piece rather than independent power. In a dedicated recovery build it is foundational; in a general loadout it is difficult to justify.
editorial.verdict: The engine behind several anti-carry builds. Flip-Flop turns slug time into wiggle pressure, but usually needs another perk or favorable geometry to convert that pressure into an escape.
